decisions.reason: As a formwork profile system line with several models and a strong fit to the firm's core prefabrication-equipment business, it is still more likely to be retained despite no recent web observation.

The shuttering magnet block complements the firm's formwork and plant solutions, but as a smaller add-on product with weak recent visibility it faces a meaningful review risk.
Magnetic formwork strips remain close to the established product logic of modular prefabrication tooling, so management would likely keep them unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.

This magnetic formwork component fits the firm's tailored modular offering, but the absence of later website evidence and possible overlap with related magnetic products increase the chance of rationalization.
